name: Carbon Forge
description: Hosted Carbon Forge MCP server: source control and a shared record for people and agents. Code, files and prose live in one record on the server; an agent opens a lane instead of cloning, and every landing is one all-or-nothing changeset. Blame, grep, diff and history run on the server. This entry connects without auth, which reads public workspaces only; writing needs a bearer token minted in Carbon Forge, which this registry entry does not configure.
